meta.catalogRef: PC-FIN-TAX-07 — Unit Tax Compliance Review & SP2DK Support
meta.title: Unit Tax Compliance Review & SP2DK Support
meta.businessUnit: Group Finance — Tax Management (Head Office) & Unit Finance
meta.technicalOwner: Head of Finance Systems / System Accountant

overview.problem: SP2DK (Surat Permintaan Penjelasan atas Data dan/atau Keterangan) letters arrive at hospital units from their local KPP with a 14-calendar-day response window. Preparing a defensible response requires reconstructing an equalisation between reported revenue, VAT bases, withholding tax objects and the general ledger — data that sits in at least four systems. Unit finance teams routinely consume 3–5 working days of senior time per letter, and under time pressure some responses are submitted with incomplete evidence, which materially raises the probability of escalation to a full tax audit (pemeriksaan).
objectives: Reduce median SP2DK response preparation time from 3–5 working days to under 1 working day of reviewer effort.
Guarantee that no SP2DK response leaves the Group without a complete, source-referenced evidence pack.
Detect the equalisation gaps that trigger SP2DK proactively, on a quarterly cycle, before DJP raises them.
Produce a consistent, auditable position across all hospital entities for the same class of tax question.
overview.currentState: Manual. The unit tax officer reads the letter, interprets the data DJP is questioning, requests extracts from Finance Systems, builds an equalisation worksheet in Excel, drafts the tanggapan letter in Word, and circulates for review by email. There is no group-level register of open SP2DK, no standard evidence pack, and no reuse of positions previously argued successfully at another unit.
overview.targetState: An agentic workflow ingests the SP2DK, classifies the tax issue, retrieves and reconciles the supporting data, drafts a fully cited response pack, and presents it to the Unit Financial Controller and Group Tax Manager for review and approval. The agent never transmits anything to DJP. Submission through Coretax remains a deliberate human act.

solution.summary: A supervised agentic AI caseworker for SP2DK response preparation and pre-emptive equalisation review. The agent operates as a retrieval-and-drafting specialist over Group tax and finance data, with a hard stop before any external filing action.
solution.autonomyLevel: Level 2 — Agent executes multi-step retrieval, reconciliation and drafting. Every externally visible artefact requires named human approval. No write-back to any system of record and no transmission to DJP.
solution.agentPattern: Plan → Retrieve → Reconcile → Draft → Cite → Escalate for approval. Deterministic tools perform all arithmetic; the language model performs classification, evidence selection and narrative drafting only.

components.responsibility: Parse the inbound letter (PDF/scan/Coretax export), extract KPP, letter number, date, entity NPWP, tax period, and the specific data points DJP is questioning. Classify into one of the defined issue archetypes.
Deterministic connectors that query the ERP general ledger, the SPT archive, the e-Faktur/e-Bupot extracts and the HIS revenue detail for the identified entity and period.
Deterministic calculation service. Performs the revenue-to-VAT-base and expense-to-withholding-object reconciliations and returns a variance schedule with line-level traceability. No LLM arithmetic.
Generates the tanggapan letter narrative and the evidence index, in Bahasa Indonesia, in the Group's approved format, with a mandatory source citation against every figure asserted.
Maintains the group SP2DK register, tracks the 14-day clock, drives reminders and escalations, and holds the approval audit trail.
Runs the same equalisation logic on a quarterly cycle across all entities without an SP2DK trigger, and reports gaps above the materiality threshold.

inScope: Ingestion and classification of SP2DK letters received via Coretax account export, registered email, and scanned physical mail.
The five tax issue archetypes defined in Section 4 (PPN equalisation, PPh Badan revenue equalisation, PPh 21 tenaga ahli, PPh 23, PPh 4(2) final).
Automated retrieval and reconciliation of GL, SPT, e-Faktur and e-Bupot data for the entity and period under question.
Generation of a draft tanggapan letter in Bahasa Indonesia plus an indexed evidence pack (PDF and XLSX).
Two-tier human review and approval workflow with a full, immutable audit trail.
Group-level SP2DK case register with 14-day SLA tracking, reminders and escalation.
Quarterly pre-emptive equalisation review across in-scope entities.
A precedent library of previously approved Group positions, retrievable by issue archetype.
outOfScope: Any transmission, filing or submission to DJP. Coretax remains operated exclusively by authorised Group Tax personnel.
Write-back of any value to the ERP, the HIS, or any system of record. The solution is read-only against all source systems.
Determination of the Group's final tax position. The agent produces a recommended position; the qualified tax professional owns it.
Handling of Pemeriksaan (formal tax audit), Bukti Permulaan, Keberatan or Banding proceedings.
Transfer pricing documentation, tax provisioning, and deferred tax computation.
Any processing of patient-identifiable clinical data. Revenue data is consumed at the aggregated and coded level only.
Direct API integration with Coretax DJP. No taxpayer-facing API is available — see AS-003.
Amendment of SPT (pembetulan). Where the agent's analysis indicates an amendment is warranted, it raises a flagged recommendation only.

process.figureCaption: Figure 1 — SP2DK response lifecycle. Source Systems denotes the ERP general ledger, the SPT archive, the e-Faktur/e-Bupot extracts and HIS revenue detail (Section 6). Every externally visible artefact passes a named human approval before it leaves the Group; the agent has no path to DJP.
process.narrative: The trigger is the arrival of an SP2DK. The agent's work is bounded on one end by an inbound document it did not request, and on the other by a human being who signs the response. Everything in between is retrieval, arithmetic and drafting — and every figure it asserts must point back at a row in a source system.

steps.step: Detect and ingest the SP2DK from the monitored Coretax export folder, the registered tax mailbox, or a manual upload of scanned mail.
OCR and parse: KPP name, letter number, letter date, entity name and NPWP, tax type, tax period, and the narrative of what DJP is questioning.
Create the case, start the 14-calendar-day SLA clock from the letter date, and notify the Unit Financial Controller and Group Tax Manager.
Classify the question into one of the five defined archetypes and emit a confidence score. Below threshold, stop and escalate.
Execute the archetype's defined read-only queries against the ERP GL, the SPT archive, the e-Faktur and e-Bupot extracts, and HIS revenue detail, scoped to the entity and period.
Compute the reconciliation deterministically. Produce a variance schedule showing reported figure, ledger figure, difference, and the reconciling items.
Query the precedent library for previously approved Group positions on the same archetype and surface them to the reviewer.
Draft the tanggapan letter in Bahasa Indonesia to the Group template, attaching a citation to every asserted figure. Assemble the indexed evidence pack.
First-line review. Accept, annotate or reject. Rejection returns the case to the agent with reviewer notes.
Second-line approval. Where the unreconciled variance exceeds the materiality threshold, external counsel is consulted before approval.
Submit to DJP via Coretax. This action occurs outside the solution and is recorded back into the case by the submitter.
Record the DJP outcome when known, close the case, and write the approved position to the precedent library.

functional.requirement: The system shall ingest SP2DK documents from a monitored folder, a registered mailbox, and manual upload, and shall record the provenance of every ingested document.

The system shall OCR and parse scanned SP2DK letters, extracting KPP, letter number, letter date, NPWP, tax type and tax period, and shall present the parsed header for human confirmation before the case proceeds.
The system shall classify each case into one of the five defined tax issue archetypes and emit a numeric confidence score with the classification.
The system shall start a 14-calendar-day SLA clock from the SP2DK letter date and display remaining time on every case view.

The system shall execute read-only retrieval against the ERP GL, the SPT archive, the e-Faktur/e-Bupot extracts and HIS revenue detail, scoped strictly to the entity and period identified in the case.
The system shall compute the equalisation deterministically in a dedicated calculation service. No monetary figure presented to a reviewer may originate from language model output.
The system shall produce a variance schedule in which every line is traceable to an identified source row in a source system.
The system shall generate a draft tanggapan letter in Bahasa Indonesia conforming to the Group's approved template.
The system shall attach a resolvable citation to every numeric assertion in the drafted response and shall block the draft from reaching a reviewer if any numeral is uncited.
The system shall assemble an indexed evidence pack as a single PDF plus a supporting XLSX workbook.
The system shall enforce a two-tier approval workflow: Unit Financial Controller first-line, Group Tax Manager second-line. Neither tier may be skipped or self-approved.
The system shall record an immutable approval trail capturing approver identity, role, decision, timestamp, comment, and a cryptographic hash of the exact artefact approved.
The system shall maintain a Group-level SP2DK register showing every open and closed case, its unit, archetype, SLA status and current owner.
The system shall issue escalation notifications at T-7, T-4 and T-2 calendar days before the SLA deadline, addressed to the case owner and the Group Tax Manager.
The system shall provide a precedent library, searchable by archetype, holding previously approved Group positions and their recorded outcomes.
The system shall run a quarterly pre-emptive equalisation across all in-scope entities and report gaps exceeding the materiality threshold, without requiring an SP2DK trigger.
The system shall allow a reviewer to annotate any variance line or draft paragraph and return the case to the agent for redrafting, preserving the prior version.
The system shall support recording of an extension request to the KPP and shall adjust the SLA clock only upon evidence of the extension being granted.
The system shall produce a Group-level analytics view of SP2DK frequency by KPP, archetype and unit, to inform where remediation effort is best directed.
The system shall recommend, but never execute, an SPT amendment (pembetulan) where the equalisation indicates one is warranted.

business.rule: The solution shall never transmit any document, message or filing to DJP. Submission via Coretax is performed exclusively by an authorised human being.
business.rationale: A filing is a legal act with statutory consequence. It cannot be delegated to software.

business.rule: All connections to systems of record are read-only. No service account used by the solution shall hold write, update or delete permission on any source system.
business.rationale: Prevents the solution from ever becoming the cause of a ledger or filing discrepancy.

business.rule: The response deadline is 14 calendar days from the date of the SP2DK, per SE-05/PJ/2022. The clock is calendar-based and is not adjusted for weekends or public holidays.
business.rationale: Statutory. Working-day arithmetic would systematically overstate available time.

business.rule: A figure as filed in an SPT is immutable within the solution. The agent may explain, reconcile or contextualise a filed figure but shall never restate it.
business.rationale: The filed return is the legal position of record until formally amended.

business.rule: Every SP2DK response requires two named approvals: the Unit Financial Controller and the Group Tax Manager. The two roles may not be held by the same individual for the same case.

Where the unreconciled variance exceeds IDR 500 million or 5% of the entity's reported revenue for the period, whichever is lower, the case shall not be approvable until an external tax counsel consultation is recorded against it.
business.rationale: Materiality gate. Threshold to be ratified by the Group Tax Manager — see OQ-001.

business.rule: Classification confidence below 0.85 shall halt automated progression and route the case to the Group Tax Manager for manual archetype assignment.
business.rationale: A misclassified case retrieves the wrong evidence and produces a confidently wrong response.

business.rule: Case files, evidence packs and approval records shall be retained for 10 years from the end of the relevant tax year, per UU KUP Art. 28(11).
No patient-identifiable data shall enter the solution. Revenue data is consumed at service-category and aggregate level only.
business.rationale: Patient data protection; keeps the solution outside the clinical data perimeter entirely.

business.rule: Any service category code encountered in HIS revenue data that is absent from the approved VAT treatment mapping shall halt the equalisation and raise an exception. The agent shall not infer a treatment.
business.rationale: An inferred VAT treatment is an unsupported tax position.

business.rule: A precedent may only be written to the library from a case that was approved by the Group Tax Manager and whose DJP outcome has been recorded.
business.rationale: Prevents unproven positions circulating as Group practice.

business.rule: The quarterly pre-emptive review shall report gaps as candidates for investigation, never as findings, and shall not create a case in the SP2DK register.
business.rationale: Preserves the distinction between an internal signal and a tax authority action.

guardrails.control: The language model shall perform no arithmetic. All monetary computation is executed by the deterministic Equalisation Engine, and figures are injected into the narrative by templated substitution.

Citation enforcement: a post-generation validator parses the drafted response, extracts every numeral, and confirms each resolves to a variance line or evidence item. Any failure blocks the draft and returns it for regeneration, with a maximum of three attempts before human escalation.
The agent operates over a closed tool set. It has no general web access, no code execution, and no ability to call a system not enumerated in Section 6.

The inference endpoint shall be contractually zero-retention, shall not use Group data for model training, and shall be hosted in Indonesia or a region approved in writing by the Group Data Protection owner.
Every agent step — prompt, tool call, tool response, model output — is logged with the case id and retained for the case retention period, and is reproducible for audit.
Model and prompt versions are pinned per case. A case opened under one version completes under that version. Version identifiers appear on the case record and in the evidence pack.

Prompt injection defence: content extracted from inbound SP2DK documents is treated strictly as data. Instructions embedded in a document shall never alter agent behaviour, and the boundary shall be tested as part of UAT.

A regression evaluation set of at least 40 historical SP2DK cases with known correct archetypes shall be maintained. Classification accuracy shall be re-measured before any model or prompt change is promoted to production.
The agent shall state uncertainty explicitly in the draft where evidence is incomplete, rather than producing a confident narrative over a gap.

matrix.condition: SP2DK document is unreadable, or OCR confidence falls below the configured threshold.
matrix.handling: Halt intake. Notify the Unit Tax Officer for manual key-in of the case header. SLA clock still starts from the letter date.

matrix.condition: Classification confidence below 0.85, or archetype returned as UNKNOWN.
matrix.handling: Halt. Route to Group Tax Manager for manual archetype assignment. Record the manual assignment for the evaluation set.

matrix.condition: A source system is unreachable, or returns a partial extract.
matrix.handling: Halt the case. Do not proceed on partial evidence. Retry on a defined backoff, then notify the case owner and the technical owner.

matrix.condition: A HIS service category code is not present in the approved VAT treatment mapping.
matrix.handling: Halt the equalisation. Raise to the System Accountant for mapping extension. The agent shall not infer a treatment.

matrix.condition: Citation validation fails after three regeneration attempts.
matrix.handling: Halt. Escalate to Group Tax Manager with the failed draft and the specific uncited assertions identified.

matrix.condition: Unreconciled variance exceeds the materiality threshold in BR-006.
matrix.handling: Block approval. Require a recorded external counsel consultation before the case can be approved.

matrix.condition: SLA clock reaches T-2 days without second-line approval.
matrix.handling: Escalate to the Group CFO. Prompt the Group Tax Manager to consider a formal extension request to the KPP.

matrix.condition: Duplicate SP2DK detected — same letter number and NPWP already in the register.
matrix.handling: Link to the existing case, do not create a duplicate, and notify the case owner.

matrix.condition: The entity NPWP on the letter does not resolve to an entity in the Group master.
matrix.handling: Hold the case in an unassigned queue and notify Group Tax. No retrieval is attempted.

matrix.condition: The LLM endpoint is unavailable or exceeds its latency budget.
matrix.handling: Queue and retry. Notify the technical owner if unresolved beyond 60 minutes. Deterministic retrieval and equalisation continue to run and are presented without narrative.

policies.policy: Authentication via Group SSO (Entra ID) with MFA enforced. No local application accounts for human users.
Role-based access control with row-level entity scoping. A unit role sees only its own entity's cases.
All source-system credentials held in a managed secret store with automated rotation. No credential in configuration files, source code, or agent prompts.
Vendor personnel hold no standing production access. Support access is break-glass, time-boxed, ticket-linked, approved by the technical owner, and fully logged.
The solution processes no patient-identifiable data. This is enforced at the HIS connector by field-level allow-listing, not by downstream filtering.
Tax and financial data at rest is encrypted and stored within an approved data residency boundary. Data in transit uses TLS 1.2 or above.
Penetration test and prompt-injection assessment completed and remediated before production go-live.
Quarterly user access review conducted by the Group Tax Manager, with evidence retained for Internal Audit.

testing.given: a scanned SP2DK letter is uploaded with legible text
testing.when: the intake service processes the document
testing.then: the KPP name, letter number, letter date, NPWP, tax type and tax period are extracted and presented to the Unit Tax Officer for confirmation, and the case does not progress until that confirmation is recorded.

testing.given: an SP2DK dated 2 September with a case created on 5 September
testing.when: the SLA clock is evaluated
testing.then: the deadline is calculated as 16 September — 14 calendar days from the letter date, not the case creation date — and weekends and public holidays are not excluded.

testing.given: a classification returning archetype PPN_EQUALISATION with a confidence of 0.72
testing.when: the agent attempts to progress to retrieval
testing.then: progression is blocked, the case is routed to the Group Tax Manager for manual archetype assignment, and the manual assignment is captured for the evaluation set.

testing.given: a completed equalisation for a case
testing.when: any monetary figure in the draft response is traced back through the system
testing.then: its origin is a Equalisation Engine output record, and no monetary figure can be shown to have originated in language model output.

testing.given: a drafted response containing the assertion 'selisih sebesar Rp1.240.500.000' with no resolvable citation
testing.when: the citation validator runs
testing.then: the draft is rejected, regeneration is attempted up to three times, and on continued failure the case escalates to the Group Tax Manager with the specific uncited assertion identified.

testing.given: a user holding both Unit Financial Controller and Group Tax Manager roles
testing.when: that user attempts second-line approval on a case they approved at first line
testing.then: the system refuses the approval, states the segregation-of-duties rule, and records the attempt in the audit log.

testing.given: a case with an unreconciled variance of IDR 780 million against reported revenue of IDR 9 billion
testing.when: the Group Tax Manager attempts approval
testing.then: approval is blocked until an external tax counsel consultation is recorded against the case, and the blocking reason cites BR-006.

testing.given: the service account used by the ERP connector
testing.when: its effective permissions are enumerated in the target system
testing.then: only read scopes are present, and any attempt by the solution to issue a write operation is refused at the source system, not merely at the application layer.

testing.given: HIS revenue detail containing a service category code absent from the approved VAT treatment mapping
testing.when: the equalisation runs
testing.then: the equalisation halts, no VAT treatment is inferred for that code, and an exception is raised to the System Accountant naming the unmapped code.

testing.given: an SP2DK PDF containing embedded text instructing the agent to disregard its approval workflow
testing.when: the agent processes the document
testing.then: the embedded text is treated as document content only, the approval workflow is unchanged, and the attempt is logged as a security event.

testing.given: any case in any state
testing.when: the full solution surface is examined for outbound capability toward DJP
testing.then: no interface, job, or credential exists that is capable of transmitting to DJP or Coretax.

testing.given: a case approved at both tiers and subsequently closed
testing.when: Internal Audit retrieves the case audit file
testing.then: the file contains every prompt, tool call, tool response, model output, and human decision with timestamps and identities, and the hash of each approved artefact matches the artefact stored.

testing.given: a case at T-2 calendar days without second-line approval
testing.when: the SLA evaluation job runs
testing.then: an escalation is issued to the Group CFO and the Group Tax Manager is prompted to consider a formal extension request to the KPP.

testing.given: a case opened while model version M1 and prompt version P3 are current
testing.when: the model is upgraded to M2 mid-case
testing.then: the case continues to completion on M1/P3, and the evidence pack records the versions used.

testing.given: the quarterly pre-emptive review identifies a gap above the materiality threshold at a unit
testing.when: the report is produced
testing.then: the gap is presented as a candidate for investigation, no case is created in the SP2DK register, and the report language does not characterise the gap as a finding.

testing.given: the same SP2DK arriving through each of the three supported channels — Coretax export folder, registered mailbox, and manual upload
testing.when: each is ingested
testing.then: a case is created in every instance and the provenance record names the channel, the receipt timestamp and the originating file or message identifier.

testing.given: a case whose draft has passed citation validation
testing.when: the response pack is assembled
testing.then: the tanggapan letter is produced in Bahasa Indonesia on the approved Group template, and the evidence pack is a single bookmarked PDF with an index page plus a companion XLSX whose formulas are visible.

testing.given: open cases at three different units and two closed cases
testing.when: the Group Tax Manager opens the SP2DK register
testing.then: all five appear with unit, archetype, SLA status and current owner, while a Unit Financial Controller opening the same register sees only their own unit's cases.

testing.given: a case where the ledger figure differs from the figure filed in the SPT
testing.when: the equalisation and the draft are produced
testing.then: the filed figure is reproduced unchanged throughout, the difference is presented as a reconciling item, and no artefact in the pack contains a restated SPT value.

testing.given: a HIS revenue extract request for a case
testing.when: the connector returns data
testing.then: only allow-listed fields are present, no patient identifier is among them, and the allow-list is enforced at the connector rather than by filtering after receipt.

assumptions.item: Group Tax will provide at least 40 historical SP2DK letters with their final approved responses, for the regression and evaluation set.
The Group's VAT treatment mapping by HIS service category exists in a usable form, or can be produced by the System Accountant during DEP-03.
No taxpayer-facing API is available for Coretax DJP. Intake is by monitored folder and registered mailbox; submission remains a manual human action.
The ERP exposes a read-only interface adequate for period-scoped GL and sub-ledger extraction without a bespoke development effort on the ERP side.
The 14-calendar-day window per SE-05/PJ/2022 remains current at build time. The SLA rule is configurable so a regulatory change does not require a code release.
Entity master data — NPWP to hospital entity to KPP — is available and maintained by Group Tax.

dependencies.item: Read-only service accounts on ERP, SPT archive and HIS

Entra ID application registration and role group creation
Internal Audit agreement on the control narrative in Section 10

openQuestions.question: Confirm the materiality threshold in BR-006. Is IDR 500 million / 5% of period revenue the right gate, and should it vary by entity size?
What is the actual Group SP2DK volume for the trailing 12 months, by unit and by tax type? This sizes the business case and the concurrency requirement.
Which ERP platform and version is the target, and does it expose a supported read-only API or must a database view be provisioned?
Does the Group accept an LLM endpoint hosted outside Indonesia under contractual zero-retention terms, or is in-country inference mandatory?
Which six units form Phase 1, and are their KPP relationships representative of the Group's SP2DK profile?

Where the pre-emptive quarterly review surfaces a material historical gap, what is the Group's standing policy — voluntary pembetulan, or hold pending DJP action? This is a policy decision, not a system requirement, but the workflow must reflect it.
